item.title: CJID seeks sanctions over Bauchi journalist assault
item.description: “CJID condemns Bauchi police assault on journalist Mohammed Adamu, demands DPO Jamilu Kabir’s suspension, transparent investigation, and coverage of medical expenses,” says Busola Ajibola, Deputy Director, CJID.

item.title: Zamfara commissioner resigns as governor, entire assembly defect to APC
item.description: Mr Madawaki said his resignation was informed by his loyalty to the PDP, stressing that he could not join the APC.

item.title: El-Rufai arraigned in Kaduna under tight security, journalists barred from courtroom
item.description: Mr El-Rufai was initially detained by the Economic and Financial Crimes Commission (EFCC) on 16 February 2026, granted bail two days later, and subsequently re-arrested by the ICPC.

item.title: I remain NURTW President - MC Oluomo declares
item.description: PREMIUM TIMES gathered that tensions flared at the union’s national secretariat in Abuja after Tajudeen Baruwa allegedly moved to assume control, citing a court ruling.

item.title: Zenith Bank appoints new Executive Director
item.description: The appointment is consistent with the Bank's tradition and succession strategy of grooming leaders from within and will further strengthen the Bank's Executive Management.

item.title: Entrepreneurs champion women’s economic empowerment at West Africa Business Summit
item.description: The speakers urged a shift towards a broader understanding of business success beyond financial gains.

item.title: Policy, funding gaps top agenda as experts meet on maternal health in Africa
item.description: The aim of the dialogue is to identify practical pathways for accelerating progress toward the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) related to maternal and newborn survival.

item.title: 2027: Support group for Mbah’s reelection inaugurates ward coordinators for Igbo-Eze South
item.description: Ugo Ferdinand Ukwueze, the chairman of Igbo-Eze South Local Government Area, who welcomed Mr Okonkwo and other dignitaries to the area, said that the gathering provided yet another opportunity for the Igbo-Eze South leaders and people to reaffirm their unalloyed support for Governor Mbah’s administration.
